notes.title: Heroine's Claw | Feature & Content update
notes.content:
Content removal

- Removed Marie's voicelines from the game.


Bug fixes

- Removed bugged pickups from the sea levels.
- Decreased camera weight while underwater.
- Fixed character being able to get stuck in a bush in the final level.
- Performance fixes for SteamOS / Steam Deck.


Quality updates

- Increased size of boss arena in the first boss fight.
- Moved a guaranteed ammo and health drop Infront of player at the start of the first boss fight.
- Increased run speed in second boss fight.
- Added a map to the ending of the game.
- Decreased the amount of angels in the final level of the game.
- Decreased bomb damage in second boss fight.
- Added two extra harpoon collection points in the second boss fight.
- Decreased camera weight while underwater.

notes.title: Heroine's Claw | Content Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44814155/48c444f1c56bf08a57d73b589630e3fa9e8c3961.png

New overhauls

- A brand new ending to the game
- A new level after the final boss fight
- New music in certain areas


New items

- Added a new weapon - [spoiler]A shotgun[/spoiler]


Bug fixes

- Fixed the "You died" continue button being un-interactable in certain instances
- Fixed a bug where you could get stuck on top of a small bush in later areas in the game
- Fixed the [spoiler]"Harvey"[/spoiler] boss fight not being able to walk onto the balcony area with the player
- Fixed certain areas you could go out of bounds in
- Fixed a portion of the UI being misplaced or scaled incorrectly on ultrawide monitors
- Fixed the clue for the first boss fight not appearing
- Fixed certain graphical issues with the "Low" pre-set
- Fixed weapons not letting you equip them in certain instances


[spoiler]Added a cheat menu, to access it open the game with the "-cheat" launch option and then click the P key[/spoiler]

notes.title: Heroine's Claw Release!
notes.content:
Heroine's Claw is now out! Thank you for anyone wish listing and following the game!! If you purchased the game on itch.io please contact me through my email here with the same email you used to purchase the game or your receipt.

New Features with the steam edition
- Achievements
- Half Controller Support (No UI to show controller buttons)

Content coming in the steam edition
- Reworked ending to the game

Please also report any feedback on the "Contact us" tab on our website
